initialExam.title: MPSC Group B Combined 2026
initialExam.description: MPSC Combined Group B exam for recruitment to PSI, STI, and ASO posts in Maharashtra. 552 vacancies notified for 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: GS (100Q, 100 marks, 1 hour). Mains: Marathi & English (100 marks), GS Paper I & II (200 marks each), Special Subject (200 marks).
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: Objective, 100Q, 100 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 4 descriptive papers, 700 marks total.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Physical Test (PSI only) → Document Verification → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Police Sub-Inspector, State Tax Inspector, Assistant Section Officer
initialExam.careerGrowth: PSI → PI → ACP → DCP. STI → STO → ACST. ASO → SO → Under Secretary.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit mpsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Pension

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
